title: Professional Biohazard & Trauma Cleaning Services - Brisbane Discreet Specialized Cleaning
description: IICRC-certified biohazard and trauma cleaning technician in complete protective equipment preparing for sensitive specialized cleaning service in Brisbane. Discreet, compassionate, professional service for sensitive situations with 25+ years specialized experience, Queensland WHS compliance, and proper biohazard waste disposal certification.
